rice.general_soil_description: Clayey, loamy, or heavy alluvial soils with high water retention capacity.
rice.general_climate_description: Warm and humid tropical/subtropical climate with abundant rainfall.
rice.general_management_guidance: Requires shallow standing water during early vegetative stages. Nitrogen application is typically split across basal, tillering, and panicle initiation stages.
rice.source: FAO Crop Information System & ICAR Rice Knowledge Portal

maize.general_soil_description: Deep, well-drained fertile loamy soils rich in organic matter.
maize.general_climate_description: Warm temperate to tropical climates with adequate sunshine.
maize.general_management_guidance: Maize is highly sensitive to waterlogging. Ensure effective field drainage and split nitrogen fertilizer applications.
maize.source: FAO EcoCrop & USDA Agricultural Extension Guidelines

chickpea.general_soil_description: Deep loamy to clayey soils with good aeration and drainage.
chickpea.general_climate_description: Cool, dry climate during growth with warm weather during maturity.
chickpea.general_management_guidance: Leguminous pulse that fixes atmospheric nitrogen via Rhizobium symbiosis. Avoid waterlogging to prevent wilt and root rot.

kidneybeans.general_soil_description: Well-drained light loamy soils rich in organic content.
kidneybeans.general_climate_description: Mild, cool climate free from severe frost.
kidneybeans.general_management_guidance: Requires uniform soil moisture during flowering and pod development. Sensitive to high salinity.

pigeonpeas.general_soil_description: Deep, well-drained alluvial or loam soil.
pigeonpeas.general_climate_description: Warm tropical climate with moderate moisture.
pigeonpeas.general_management_guidance: Deep-rooted, drought-tolerant legume. Excellent candidate for intercropping with cereal crops.

mothbeans.general_soil_description: Sandy or light loamy well-drained arid soils.
mothbeans.general_climate_description: Hot, dry semi-arid to arid climate.
mothbeans.general_management_guidance: Extremely drought-resistant pulse suited for rainfed dryland farming with minimal input requirements.

mungbean.general_soil_description: Well-drained loamy to sandy loam soils.
mungbean.general_climate_description: Warm, humid weather with moderate rainfall.
mungbean.general_management_guidance: Short-duration leguminous crop suitable for soil fertility enhancement in crop rotations.

blackgram.general_soil_description: Heavy clay to loamy soils with adequate organic content.
blackgram.general_management_guidance: Prefers warm temperatures. Susceptible to water stagnation during early vegetative stages.

lentil.general_soil_description: Light loamy to alluvial clay soils.
lentil.general_climate_description: Cool growing season with dry harvest weather.
lentil.general_management_guidance: Thrives in cool winter temperatures. Requires well-aerated soil for root nodulation.

pomegranate.general_soil_description: Deep, well-drained sandy loam or alluvial soil.
pomegranate.general_climate_description: Semi-arid climate with hot dry summers and mild winters.
pomegranate.general_management_guidance: Requires pruning for canopy structure and fruit quality. Sensitive to soil moisture fluctuations during fruit development.

banana.general_soil_description: Deep, fertile loamy soil high in organic matter with quick drainage.
banana.general_climate_description: Humid tropical climate with uniform warmth.
banana.general_management_guidance: Heavy nutrient and water feeder. High potassium requirements for fruit development.

mango.general_soil_description: Deep alluvial to well-drained loamy soil.
mango.general_climate_description: Tropical to subtropical climate with a distinct dry period for flowering.
mango.general_management_guidance: Requires dry weather during flower initiation and blooming to prevent fungal anthracnose.

grapes.general_soil_description: Well-drained sandy loam or gravelly clay soil.
grapes.general_climate_description: Warm Mediterranean or semi-arid climate with bright dry weather during ripening.
grapes.general_management_guidance: Requires trellis support and systematic canopy management. High potassium uptake is essential for fruit sugar accumulation.
grapes.source: ICAR National Research Centre for Grapes

watermelon.general_soil_description: Rich sandy loam soil with excellent internal drainage.
watermelon.general_climate_description: Hot, dry climate with long warm sunny days.
watermelon.general_management_guidance: Prefers dry weather during fruit ripening to boost brix sugar content.

muskmelon.general_soil_description: Well-drained sandy loam soil rich in organic humus.
muskmelon.general_management_guidance: Avoid leaf wetting via overhead irrigation during maturity to minimize powdery mildew.

apple.general_soil_description: Deep, well-drained loamy soil rich in organic matter.
apple.general_climate_description: Temperate climate with adequate winter chilling hours for dormancy break.
apple.general_management_guidance: Requires winter chill hours (700-1000 hrs < 7°C depending on cultivar) and regular potassium supplementation.

orange.general_soil_description: Deep, well-drained sandy loam or clay loam soil.
orange.general_climate_description: Subtropical to tropical climate with moderate humidity.
orange.general_management_guidance: Sensitive to soil waterlogging and excessive salinity. Micronutrient supplementation (Zinc, Boron) improves fruit set.

papaya.general_soil_description: Rich loamy soil with rapid drainage and organic content.
papaya.general_climate_description: Warm tropical climate free from frost.
papaya.general_management_guidance: Extremely susceptible to root rot if soil remains waterlogged for over 48 hours. Ensure elevated planting beds.

coconut.general_soil_description: Coastal alluvial, sandy loam, or well-drained lateritic soil.
coconut.general_climate_description: Warm, humid tropical coastal climate with high sunshine.
coconut.general_management_guidance: High potassium demand. Requires consistent soil moisture and atmospheric humidity.

cotton.general_soil_description: Deep black cotton soil (Vertisols) or fertile alluvial soil.
cotton.general_climate_description: Warm, sunny climate with long frost-free period.
cotton.general_management_guidance: Requires warm weather during boll development and dry sunny conditions during harvest.

jute.general_management_guidance: Requires high humidity and warm temperatures. Access to clean water bodies is necessary for fiber retting.
jute.source: ICAR-Central Research Institute for Jute and Allied Fibres

coffee.general_soil_description: Deep, porous, friable loamy soil rich in organic humus.
coffee.general_climate_description: Humid subtropical or tropical highland climate under canopy shade.
coffee.general_management_guidance: Grown under partial shade trees on sloping land to prevent soil erosion. Regular pruning maintains bush structure.
coffee.source: FAO Coffee Cultivation Manual & Coffee Board Advisory
